name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after a career in journalism. He covered various beats, but a chance assignment at the Singapore Grand Prix ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. He was captivated by the raw energy and the complex interplay of technology and human skill.

He transitioned into motorsport, bringing his sharp storytelling and media relations skills to Ipiranga Racing. Tan's approach is rooted in authenticity and strategic communication. He believes in building genuine connections with the media and fans, emphasizing the human element behind the roaring engines. His visionary approach to PR has helped Ipiranga Racing cultivate a strong brand image and a loyal following.

What sets Tan apart is his uncanny ability to anticipate media trends and craft compelling narratives that resonate with diverse audiences. He's not just selling speed; he's selling a story, a dream, a piece of the racing spirit.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on the left side
physical.description: A man of average height with a thoughtful gaze and a neatly groomed appearance.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War'.
Insists on using a vintage typewriter for drafting initial press releases.
Has a peculiar habit of humming classical music while strategizing.
